newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani rupee ends down in kerb, seen stable.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended 0.04 down at 41.18 to the dollar in the kerb market on Tuesday amid higher buying of the U.S. currency by traders, dealers said.
The rupee is likely to open stable on Wednesday, one dealer said.
The State (central) bank of Pakistan rate, last changed on October 22, was 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar.
The premium on foreign exchange bearer certificates closed unchanged at 2.70 percent. -- Ibrahim Khan 9221-5685192
